meta_description:
prattprattpratt on October 22, 2026: "Honored to be sitting down with one of my best friends, former Navy Seal and co-star in Terminal List, Jared Shaw.

While I have had the pleasure of getting to know him over the years, I wanted to share his story with everyone as it’s one that was inspiring to me, and I’m sure will be inspiring to all of you. 

Here’s part 1 of our conversation, and stay tuned for more.".
